name: Galery Visit John Lie-A-FO
author: Lavievita
description:
Instructions TO WALK: Click on 'show more' down below.
Website John: https://www.johnlieafo.com
Credits project build: https://www.lavievita.nl/


Use the WASD keys on keyboard to move

- Click on play (‘game’ will load)
- Click on the ’game’
- Click on sound (off by default)
- Click once more on the ‘game'
- Click on full screen (square next to sound)
- Click on the ‘game', now you can start walking.

NOTE: Only on desktop/ Laptop
